file_id: Deputy Chief Engineer vs Vinod Kumar Sahu on 3 February, 2026

sentences.text:
Deputy Chief Engineer vs Vinod Kumar Sahu on 3 February,
2026
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Jabalpur
 Fa No. 1002 of 2025
 (Deputy Chief Engineer Vs Vinod Kumar Sahu And O
 Dated : 03-02-2026
Shri Shyam Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Dhirendra Kumar Khare - Advocate for the responden
Shri Somesh Gupta - P.L. for the respondents/State.
Heard on I.A. No.16400/2025, an application for ignoring the default.
From perusal of the checker's report, it is found that default has been removed, thus, the application I.A. No.16400/2025 is rendered infructuous and disposed of.

The question in regard to limitation in filing the appeal under Section 74 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Subject to decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court, issue notice to the respondents on I.A.
No.14319/2025 and I.A. No.14320/2025 on payment of PF within three working days by RAD mode.
Notice be made returnable within four weeks.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the actual amount of compensation has already been disbursed to the claimant.
It is also submitted that the appellant is ready to deposit the enhanced compensation granted by the Reference Court.

Subject to deposit of enhanced amount of compensation with the 2 FA-1002-2025 executing Court,
the operation of the judgment and decree dated 26.08.2022 shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The Executing Court is directed to invest the enhanced amount in Fixed Deposit in the Nationalized Bank.
The disbursement of the same shall be subject to furnishing of the security by the respondents with the satisfaction of the Executing Court.
